How many Malkavian can take an action between turns (the card

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Chwizz wrote:
> Several questions about Madness Network :
> How many Malkavian can take an action between turns (the card
> says "any", and that means "one" or "one or more") ?

Not "between turns", but rather "after another Methuselah has
finished all of [her] minion phase actions".

It means "as many as want to" - zero or one or more.

> Can players play reaction cards during their turn ?

Reaction cards can be played when another Methuselah's minion is
taking an action, regardless of whose turn it is.
